name: fiber-route-ambiguity-preflight-analysis
instr:
Give Fiber applications a preflight route audit that reveals ambiguous or unreachable registrations before requests are served. The audit must use the same method, normalized path, hostname, constraint, and precedence languages as live dispatch, returning reproducible path and host witnesses. It must work through `Router.AuditRoutes` on `App`, `Group`, and `domainRouter` without changing routing behavior.

Every pair of independently authored endpoints with an overlapping request language is reported in registration order, while middleware composition, automatic method copies, and same-source registrations are classified or attributed rather than mistaken for competitors. Static, named, optional, wildcard, greedy, and escaped segments follow live normalization, with built-in and analyzable custom constraints proving intersections or disjointness and unknown custom intersections producing `RouteConflictIndeterminate`. Group audits honor effective prefixes and inherited middleware while excluding sibling scopes, and domain audits require overlapping hostname applicability while distinguishing ordinary fallback routes. Registration identity is preserved through mounting, nesting, merging, handler boundaries, naming, and multi-method expansion, so route naming affects only displayed names and never the identities, ownership, composed scope, or request-visible order attributed to a finding.
